name: Haiku dividend growth and income
strategy: Defensive value rotation with tactical shorts on overheated momentum sectors; longs in lagging value/dividend/low-vol paired with shorts in extreme-outperformers (semis, small-caps), betting on mean reversion and dividend outperformance over 5-month window.
novelty: Contrarian short positioning on extreme SOXL (+506.8% YTD) and TNA (+106.2% YTD) overvaluation paired with long mean-reversion plays in value/dividend/low-vol that have lagged. Differs fundamentally from R1 (pure long dividend aristocrats, no shorts) and R2 (long tactical small-cap/semi overweights) by employing sector-rotation bearish thesis, short discipline, and daily stop/target monitoring rather than buy-and-hold or momentum extension.
